title: My own “best ever” sugar cookie recipe! Buttery and soft cookies with...
description: My own “best ever” sugar cookie recipe! Buttery and soft cookies with a strong vanilla flavour, that won’t spread (but do require a chilling period 😛). The perfect easy Christmas cookie!  . . #sugarcookies #cookies #christmas #christmascookies #royalicing #royalicingcookies #cookiedecorating
transcript: Okay, I know everyone says their sugar cookie dough is the best ever. So to keep up, I gotta say, mine's the best ever. It is buttery and delicious. It will not spread, but it does require chilling time. There's a lot of no-spread, no-chill recipes going around. And like, I'm sure some of them are good, but usually there's no shortcuts in baking. Like, there's steps for a reason. And in order to get a cookie that doesn't spread without chill time, you have to compromise on something else, and that's probably the ratio of butter to sugar and flour, AKA the texture and flavor. So if you want a truly buttery, soft, delicious cookie, you just have to plan a little bit ahead. Prep the dough, go do something else for an hour. You can even prep it the day before if you want. And I promise you the results are worth it.
